title: Inverse Semiclassical Scattering at Fixed Energy
summary: We investigate inverse scattering at a fixed energy for semiclassical Schrödinger operators with smooth potentials. For compactly supported potentials satisfying a natural virial condition, we prove that $ \liminf_{h\to0} \|S_1(λ,h)-S_2(λ,h)\|<\sqrt{2} $ implies $V_1=V_2$, provided the fixed energy $λ$ lies above both potentials. We then consider radial short-range repulsive potentials.
